name: claude-code
updateCommand: n="Claude Code"; x="$(command -v claude)" || { echo "$n is not installed or not on PATH." >&2; exit 127; }; r() { t="$1"; i=0; while [ -L "$t" ] && [ $i -lt 40 ]; do l="$(readlink "$t")"; case "$l" in /*) t="$l" ;; *) t="${t%/*}/$l" ;; esac; i=$((i+1)); done; }; r "$x"; I=""; S=""; for y in "$x" "$t"; do case "$y" in */mise/installs/*) z="${y#*/mise/installs/}"; I="${y%%/mise/installs/*}/mise/installs/${z%%/*}"; break ;; esac; D="$y"; while [ "${D%/*}" != "$D" ]; do D="${D%/*}"; if [ -f "$D/.mise.backend.toml" ] || [ -f "$D/.mise.backend" ]; then I="$D"; break 2; fi; done; done; case "$x" in */mise/shims/*) S=1 ;; */shims/*) [ "$t" != "$x" ] && [ "${t##*/}" = mise ] && S=1 ;; esac; case "${I##*/}" in node|nodejs|bun) ;; *) if [ -n "$I$S" ]; then M="${I%/installs/*}"; [ -n "$I" ] || M="${x%/shims/*}"; export MISE_DATA_DIR="${MISE_DATA_DIR:-$M}"; m="$(command -v mise)" || { [ -n "$S" ] && [ "${t##*/}" = mise ] && m="$t"; }; k="$(sed -n "s/^short = \"\(.*\)\"$/\1/p" "$I/.mise.backend.toml" 2>/dev/null)"; case "${I##*/}" in npm-anthropic-ai-claude-code|"") k="${k:-npm:@anthropic-ai/claude-code}" ;; esac; k="${k:-${I##*/}}"; [ -n "$m" ] || { echo "$n is installed by mise (${I:-$x}), but mise is not on PATH. Run: mise upgrade --bump $k" >&2; exit 3; }; o="$(cd && "$m" which --plugin claude 2>/dev/null)"; case "$o" in "") echo "$n is installed by mise (${I:-$x}), but no mise config in your home directory selects it. Run: mise use -g $k@latest" >&2; exit 3 ;; node|nodejs|bun|core:node|core:bun) r "$(cd && "$m" which claude)" ;; *) cd && MISE_YES=1 "$m" upgrade --bump "$o" && exit; echo "Updating $n with mise failed. Run: mise upgrade --bump $o" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; fi ;; esac; h="$(readlink "$x" 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$x")"; case "$h" in */Caskroom/*) z="${h#*/Caskroom/}"; exec brew upgrade --cask "${z%%/*}" ;; */Cellar/*) z="${h#*/Cellar/}"; exec brew upgrade "${z%%/*}" ;; esac; case "$t" in */lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/*) P="$(cd "${t%%/lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/*}" && pwd)"; G="$(npm prefix -g 2>/dev/null)"; if [ "$(cd "$P" && pwd -P)" != "$(cd "${G:-/-}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P)" ]; then N="$P/bin/npm"; [ -x "$N" ] || N="$(command -v npm)" || { echo "$n was installed with npm into $P, but npm is not on PATH." >&2; exit 3; }; "$N" install -g --allow-scripts=@anthropic-ai/claude-code --prefix "$P" @anthropic-ai/claude-code && exit; echo "Updating $n with npm failed. Run: npm install -g --allow-scripts=@anthropic-ai/claude-code --prefix $P @anthropic-ai/claude-code" >&2; exit 1; fi ;; esac; exec claude update
